memory.content: When the user approves a gift STORY to archive, add that poster's X handle to the gift watchlist without a separate account-approve step.
Present gift STORY candidates as a multi-select widget (multiple choices optional), not a plaintext-only list.

Standing taste boosts (not hard filters): AI/tech policy; space including SpaceX, Blue Origin, and strong space reporting. Always mix other strong gifts. Default present at least 6 candidates when available (prefer 6–8). Learn from approve/reject over time.

Goal is to archive the story. Gift tokens and unlock URL params are one method — if the piece is free or a local archive app can save the URL cleanly, use that; if URL save fails, capture signed-in browser HTML and import instead.
Requires the X connector for discovery. Pair with a local article-archive app (or similar) on the user's machine for ingest after STORY approve.

skills.name: Gift Links story approve UI
skills.description: Use when presenting gift STORY candidates — always multi-select widget; same-day exclude already-presented post IDs without asking the user to omit.
skills.content:
---
name: Gift Links story approve UI
description: >-
  Use when presenting gift STORY candidates — always multi-select widget;
  same-day exclude already-presented post IDs without asking the user to omit.
---
When presenting gift-link STORY candidates (routine or on-demand), always use an interactive multi-select question widget — never a plaintext-only numbered list as the only ask.

## Required present shape

1. Short skimmable preamble (count + pubs).
2. One question widget with multiSelect true, one option per STORY candidate (label: pub + title; value: stable id such as post id or canonical article key).
3. Remind once that approving a story also adds that sharer to the watchlist.
4. Do not start browser capture / archive ingest until they submit picks.

## Same-day exclude (no re-ask)

Before building the candidate list, load post IDs / article keys already presented today (user local timezone calendar day) from agent memory or a small same-day ledger.

- Exclude those from the new offer list automatically.
- Do not ask the user to rerun and omit options already presented today.
- If every candidate was already shown today, send a quiet line (no fresh gifts worth offering) instead of a duplicate widget.

## Anti-patterns

- Plaintext reply with numbers as the only approve UX
- Re-offering the same post IDs later the same day
- Asking the user to manually list omissions

skills.name: Gift Links taste memory
skills.description: Use for ranking and list size — durable approve/reject taste memory (AI + space as boosts, never hard filters); default present at least 6 candidates when available.
skills.content:
---
name: Gift Links taste memory
description: >-
  Use for ranking and list size — durable approve/reject taste memory (AI +
  space as boosts, never hard filters); default present at least 6 candidates
  when available.
---
Keep gift-story taste durable across runs. Prefer breadth. Never turn one approve into a hard topic filter.

## Standing taste (seed — keep updated in agent memory)

Boost topics/authors the user has taught:
- AI / tech policy / AI companies (when the story is strong)
- Space / SpaceX / Blue Origin
- Strong space reporters

These are boosts, not an allowlist. Other strong gifts from in-scope pubs still belong in the offer list.

## Rules

1. Approve / reject learning. When the user picks STORIES to archive, boost those pubs/topics/authors/sharers. When they decline or skip a theme repeatedly, dampen it — do not erase other topics.
2. Never one-boost hard filter. One AI approve must not mean AI only forever. Always mix: boosted themes first, then other high-engagement in-scope gifts.
3. Default present at least 6 when that many distinct good candidates exist after archive dedupe and same-day exclude. Prefer 6–8. Only go below 6 when the corpus is genuinely thin — say so in the preamble.
4. Recall before each poll. Load taste memory + gift-sharer watchlist before ranking.
5. Preamble. Name how many candidates and which pubs/themes are represented so breadth is visible.

## Anti-patterns

- Shrinking the list to 2–3 AI-only items after one AI boost
- Asking them to re-teach space preferences every session
- Treating soft preference as a hard allowlist

skills.name: Gift watchlist auto-grow
skills.description: Use when gift-link discovery should auto-add the posting account to the watchlist whenever the user approves a story — never ask for per-account watchlist approval.
skills.content:
---
name: Gift watchlist auto-grow
description: >-
  Use when gift-link discovery should auto-add the posting account to the
  watchlist whenever the user approves a story — never ask for per-account
  watchlist approval.
---
When the user approves a story for archive/capture from a gift-link discovery list, automatically add the social account that posted that gift link to the durable watchlist. Do not ask them to approve watchlist accounts one-by-one.

## Rules

1. Story approve is the only gate. User picks which stories to archive/capture. That pick is also the watchlist signal.
2. On each approved story: identify the posting account (e.g. X handle), add it to agent memory under the gift watchlist, dedupe handles, persist immediately.
3. Do not send a separate add-to-watchlist question after story approve.
4. When reporting capture results, mention adds briefly once.
5. Before each discovery poll, load the current watchlist from memory.
6. Prefer watchlist shares in ranking when engagement is similar to a random share.

## Anti-patterns

- Asking for per-account watchlist approval
- Growing the watchlist from stories the user declined
- Growing from retweets/replies noise without a real gift URL on an approved story

Discovery routines still wait for story picks before browser capture / ingest. Auto-watchlist does not mean auto-capture.
